about: Size budgets for the shipped page. Baseline v4.3.1: 674 KB raw, 195 KB gzip, no fonts. Raise on purpose only. 2026-10-12: raised from 820 / 240 KB because the owner-control layer and its Studio panes (text replacement, scoring constants, built-in details, safety tools) and the security fixes were added; the page is 823.6 KB / 239.7 KB. Axel can veto. 2026-10-28: video_kb added for the home page demo video (24 MB), so a large file cannot be added by accident. 2026-10-31: gzip raised from 248 to 250 KB for the typed-number fix (98,8 was read as 988 or dropped, depending on the browser) and the https backup redirect; the page was 247.8 KB. 2026-11-04: gzip raised from 250 to 252 KB with the owner's OK, for the security release that removes every inline event handler (one allowlisted dispatcher) and enforces Trusted Types; the page is 251.6 KB. 2026-11-08: raised to 270 KB gzip and 880 KB raw for Smart fill, the optional offline document reader (owner's decision: one self-contained page, budget raised to the measured size, at most 330 KB gzip). The readers (zip, XML, PDF, Office, OpenDocument, email, RTF, JSON, HTML, text) take the page from 257.5 to 268.4 KB gzip. 2026-11-09: raised to 305 KB gzip and 960 KB raw for the rest of Smart fill (label dictionary, engine, resolution, review screen, Studio section): the page is 301.5 KB gzip, 950 KB raw, within the owner's 330 KB cap. 2026-11-09: raised to 307 KB gzip and 965 KB raw for Smart fill v5.1.0 (background thread, owner's choice of a Worker at STOP C): the page is 306.5 KB gzip, 964.0 KB raw, within the owner's 330 KB cap.
